capabilities: Assign automatic icons to folders and files based on their type and extension
Change any item's icon from Obsidian's icon set or uploaded custom images
Style an item's icon color, name color, background, bold, italic and text size
Make contents inherit a styled folder's colors and text style
Upload, manage and clear custom icons and per-item styles in settings
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README notes limitations: styles apply only to the file explorer, not bookmarks, search results or tab headers, and heavily restyled themes may misalign icons. Uploaded icons are stored in the plugin's folder and users are responsible for image rights.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows every item with the same plain look, so folders and file types are hard to tell apart at a glance.
summary: File explorer decorator that gives every folder and file a type-based icon plus per-item colors and text styles chosen from a right-click menu.
